scope: Bounded native email verification lifecycle and cross-platform Counter dialog repair

verification: Expected email plus Auth-confirmed email check before updating local verified state and authStore
Mounted-email generation and account-change/sign-out fences reject delayed work
Single-flight polling and explicit timer/listener cleanup
Normal matching-user profile setup remains intact
counter: Same native Modal/TextInput/review/cancel flow on Android and iOS
Strict positive integer-cent amount up to numeric(12,2) maximum
Capability requires compatible serialized legacy endpoint before enabling Counter
Review snapshot is re-read before mutation; local duplicate lock; no automatic mutation retry
Ambiguous responses lead to Check status; close/account changes suppress stale completion

lint.warningScope: Pre-existing ChatScreen warnings only; VerifyEmailScreen, CounterOfferDialog and new harness have zero warnings

backendContract.mutation: respond_offer(p_offer_id uuid,p_action text,p_counter_amount numeric) returns void
backendContract.installation: Backend lane supplies compatible migration; no hosted deployment performed by this lane. Counter is unavailable on an environment without that capability.

limits: Synthetic native adapters execute actual components and shipping chat action; no physical device or simulator was exercised
Legacy endpoint has no request-id/version contract; UI makes no such guarantee
Backend transaction/permission tests and installation evidence are owned by backend/root lanes
Other native warning/lifecycle work remains outside this bounded repair
